creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 13, item 9. Also tracked on main as `a_1WSCzejpV`.

The checker types a map literal as `{ str: <join of all values> }`, so a state map with mixed value types flags every field use:

```rad
st = {"buf": "", "toks": []}
st.buf += "x"   // hint[RAD30002]: cannot do 'str|list += str'
```

On one CLI that was about 30 hints. On main it is also an error in one case: passing that `st` to a parameter typed `{ "buf": str, "toks": str[] }` is RAD30001 (`'{ str: str|list }' is not assignable`), which stops the script from running.

Fixes, in order of value: infer per-key types for map literals (builtins already produce struct-map types); document typed locals (`st: { "buf": str, "toks": str[] } = {...}`, which works today but appears only in the RAD40011 entry of reference/errors, not guide/type-annotations or SYNTAX.md).

Where: map-literal typing in `rts/check/type_check.go`.
title: Map literals widen to one value type, so mixed-value maps draw hints and fail struct-typed params
